notes: Names are the plain official Statbel names, taken from the sector geometry. The REFNIS code list gives the same names but appends a parenthetical arrondissement to 15 homonyms (“Halle (Halle-Vilvoorde)”, “Tielt (Tielt)”) as a uniqueness device; that suffix is not part of the name and is not reproduced here. The only genuine disagreement between the two sources is the German name of NIS 82039, where the geometry gives the exonym Bastnach and the code list repeats the French Bastogne; the exonym is kept.
prov is null for the 19 municipalities of the Brussels-Capital Region, which belongs to no province.
No English names. English exists nowhere at source and is supplied only by the curated override in web/data/i18n/en.json.

statbel_refnis_2025.role: Independent confirmation of the 565-code current set, and the authority for the dates: DT_VLDT_START and DT_VLDT_END give the exact day each code was retired or created.
